title: Junior Backend Developer (ref: JBD)
description:
Who is your team

You will be part of the R&D team who is in charge of the development, deployment and maintenance of the Certego service portal.
Your activities will consist of:

- Collaborating with other members of your group in the development of the components for Certego service portal

- Design and maintain the architecture of Certego service portal backend

- Actively participating in the design process of new features and integrations with other Certego applications or with third party solutions

What we expect from you

- Master's degree in Computer Engineering or Information Sciences; alternatively, at least two years of specific experience developing web applications.

- Ability to manage and organize your work independently.

- Predisposition to team work.

- Attitude to learning and constant desire to develop new skills.

The following technical skills will constitute a plus::

- Experience with:

- Python (Django, Celery)

- Git

- Docker

- PostgreSQL

- ElasticSearch

- Redis/Valkey

- Experience in web application development

- Knowledge of REST

- Knowledge of Cybersecurity.

- Knowledge of Continuous Integration (CI) and Quality Assurance (QA).

What we offer

Training:

- Technical training: on reference technologies through certifications and participation in courses and events

- Training on the job: coached by more experienced colleagues

- Soft skills: we think professionalism is not only a matter of technical skills, so you will be trained on transversal skills (e.g. time management, team working, etc.)

Work environment:

- Young

- Innovative

- Close-knit

- Collaborative

Remuneration range: 25.000 – 30.000€ and/or commensurate with your skills and potential.

The workplace is Via F. Lamborghini 81, Modena, MO (Italy); we are available to evaluate forms of smart working. Working hours are in the Central European Time Zone but we are open to different solutions.

title: Junior Infrastructure Engineer Intern (ref: JIE)
description:
Who is your Team

You will join the Infrastructure and IT Services Area, which manages the development and maintenance of the IT services used by Certego, in the role of Junior Infrastructure Engineer. Your activities will include:

- Administering cloud (AWS) and on-premise infrastructures, with the goal of ensuring stability and security.

- System monitoring and troubleshooting.

- Providing technical support to colleagues, contributing to the resolution of requests and incidents.

- Collaborating with the Delivery team in the activation and configuration of services.

- Contributing to the continuous improvement of the infrastructure through proposals and optimizations.

What we expect from you

We are looking for a candidate with the following characteristics:

- Good knowledge of Linux operating systems, Linux shell, system services management (systemd, networking, logging), and CLI tools.

- Troubleshooting skills at the operating system and network levels.

- Basic knowledge of physical server management, such as: RAID configuration, hardware diagnostics, and Out-of-band remote management interfaces (IPMI).

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

- Proactivity in suggesting improvements.

- A problem-solving mindset.

What we offer

Training:

- Technical: on core technologies through certification paths and participation in courses and events.

- On-the-job: working alongside more experienced colleagues.

- Soft skills: for us, professionalism is not just technical, so you will be included in a training path on transversal skills (e.g., public speaking, communication styles, etc.).

Benefits:

- Work tools: PC, smartphone.

- Electronic meal vouchers worth €10.00.

- Corporate welfare program.

- Supplementary health insurance.

- Smart working.

Company Context:

- Young

- Innovative

- Close-knit

- Collaborative

This is an intern position; however, we are available to discuss different arrangements depending on the candidate's skills and potential.

The workplace is located at Via F. Lamborghini 81, Modena, MO (Italy), and working hours follow the Central European Time (CET) zone.
